name: Kaladatta
notes: Constant intellectual tension. Kaladatta sees structure; Renu sees meaning in structure.

name: Vasu
notes: Respectful collaboration; both work with incomplete knowledge but different interpretations.

name: Senaka
notes: Strong intellectual synergy; she provides oral patterns, he analyzes structural patterns.

name: Balamitra
notes: Limited interaction; viewed as non-academic authority.

name: Nara
notes: Respectful but cautious; she guards ritual meaning, he tries to decode it.
